about: Words of the official PDF that script_anomalies() reports after decoding, each reviewed against the rendered page. Every other word of every § must be in one script.

35.PIN-код: printed Latin abbreviation in a Ukrainian compound
35.sms-повідо́млення: printed Latin abbreviation in a Ukrainian compound
35.веб-API: printed Latin abbreviation in a Ukrainian compound
35.флеш-BIOS: printed Latin abbreviation in a Ukrainian compound

129.іa: foreign ending -ia; encoded as Cyrillic і + Latin a, both glyphs shared by the scripts, so the print cannot decide

150.ó: the Polish letter ó cited by the rule (Польське ó, наявне в суфіксі -ów)

34.IР: margin label -ІР- (beside -ИР-); encoded as Latin I + Cyrillic Р, both glyphs shared by the scripts, so the print cannot decide
